headline: Six Fronts See Heavy Base Turnover
war_summary: Three hours on, the tempo of strategic‑base exchanges has shifted across the most contested sectors. Weathered Expanse has climbed to thirty‑seven flips in the last day, up from the thirty‑four reported earlier, with Colonial casualties near 13,600 and Warden losses around 17,700; enlistments there now accelerate to roughly 82 per hour. Fishermans Row remains the busiest theatre but has slipped to thirty‑eight flips from forty‑two, the fighting still centred on Black Well, Fort Ember, Eidolo, Hangman’s Court and Arcadia. Stlican Shelf reports thirty‑one flips, down from thirty‑five, spread over Thornhold, The Pale House, Vulpine Watch and neighbouring outposts. Mooring County has fallen to fifteen daily flips from eighteen, while Farranac Coast holds steady at eleven. Linn Mercy shows a modest dip to eighteen flips from twenty, driven by renewed action at Lathair. Stonecradle eases to ten flips. Across all active zones enlistment rates are accelerating, indicating fresh manpower feeding the exchanges, while quieter fronts such as Acrithia, Allods Bight and the northern Warden‑held regions remain static with negligible casualty change.
